_comment: Master Experiment Configuration - Two Swarm Options Comparison
_description: When limited_testing=true: only IG_BS (inf comm = Rinf) and IGd_BM (limited comm = R5)
_comment_strategies: Define the strategy configurations and their corresponding config file paths (greedy_ig, dec_mcts, mh_dec_mcts_full, mh_dec_mcts_efficient)

d_uct._comment: gamma: D-UCT tree discount per MCTS iteration (paper Eq. 4-5). decay_factor/threshold_steps: teammate-intent weight decay_factor**(age_steps/threshold_steps), ignored when older than 2*threshold_steps

async._comment: Simulated asynchronous planning for dec_mcts and mh_*: each step every planner (each agent's LLP and HLP, or Dec-MCTS) runs its iteration budget in slices_per_step slices; intents are exchanged (range-limited) only between slices. Deterministic. enabled=false: synchronous HLP-then-LLP per step
